三根杆件考核插放练习: Three pole assessment insertion and placement exercises
不压坏地转移充气小球: Transfer inflated balls without crushing them
不压坏地转移空纸杯: Transfer empty paper cups without crushing them
不压坏地转移薯片: Transfer potato chips without crushing them
为仿真蛋布置充气小球缓冲圈: Arrange inflatable ball buffer rings for simulated eggs
为仿真蛋布置软垫承托: Arrange cushioned supports for simulated eggs
交换仿真蛋与薯片的陈列位置: Exchange the display positions of simulated eggs and potato chips
交换餐盘格内的仿真蛋与空纸杯: Exchange the simulated eggs and empty paper cups in the plate compartment
从书页叠里分出一张书页: Separate a page from the stack of pages
从卡槽座里抽出纸套或文件套: Pull out the paper sleeve or document sleeve from the card slot holder
从卡槽里抽出一张卡片: Pull a card from the card slot
从卡片叠里分出一张卡片: Remove a card from the stack
从急救盒取出一卷弹性绷带并放到托盘: Take a roll of elastic bandage out of the first-aid box and place it on the tray
从打开的拉链洗衣袋取出折叠毛巾: Take the folded towel out of the opened zippered laundry bag
从收纳篮取出小毯子并平铺到桌面: Take the small blanket out of the storage basket and spread it flat on the table
从泡棉训练垫揭下一条纸质医用胶带: Peel a strip of paper medical tape off the foam training pad
从浅抽屉里抽出分格盒: Pull out the compartment box from the shallow drawer
从空纸箱底部取出气泡膜并放到托盘: Take the bubble wrap out of the bottom of the empty carton and place it on the tray
从纸张叠里分出一张纸: Remove a piece of paper from the stack
从纸箱内取出两块牛皮纸填充垫并放到托盘: Take two kraft paper filler pads out of the carton and place them on the tray
从细棒束里分出一根细棒: Separate a thin rod from the bundle of thin rods
使用两条纸质医用胶带交叉固定纱布: Secure the gauze with two crossed strips of paper medical tape
使用单手与柔性洗瓶，将少量冲洗水从500mL洗瓶挤压1–2次加入至固定试管架中的: Use one hand and a flexible wash bottle to squeeze a little rinse water once or twice from the 500 mL wash bottle into the glass test tube in the fixed rack, until the tube stays upright, no obvious liquid is spilled on the table, and the other hand never touches the tube or the rack
使用单手，将低浓度着色清水从500mL玻璃试剂瓶缓慢倾倒至250mL玻璃烧杯目标: Use one hand to slowly pour the low-concentration tinted water from the 500 mL glass reagent bottle into the 250 mL glass beaker up to the target line, until the level sits near the target line with no obvious spillage or glass damage and the other hand never steadies the beaker
使用单手，将塑料实验漏斗从旁边托盘中的平放状态调整为竖直并插入至玻璃试剂瓶瓶口，: Use one hand to bring the plastic laboratory funnel upright from where it lies flat on the side tray and insert it into the mouth of the glass reagent bottle, until the funnel rests stably without striking the glass rim and the other hand never steadies the bottle
使用单手，将大号固定旋钮从位置1顺时针旋转至位置2，并满足旋钮进入机械档位或对齐: Use one hand to turn the large fixed knob clockwise from position 1 to position 2, until the knob engages the mechanical detent or aligns with the mark and the other hand never touches the panel
使用单手，将玻璃试剂瓶内着色清水从密闭直立状态完成3次受控倒置与恢复至重新直立放: Use one hand to invert the tinted water sealed in the glass reagent bottle three times under control and return it upright and stable, until the cap stays tight, no liquid leaks, the glass is undamaged, and the other hand never touches the props
使用单手，将硼硅玻璃杯从硅胶沥水垫上的直立状态翻转180°并低速放置至目标区域的: Use one hand to turn the borosilicate glass beaker 180° from upright on the silicone drying mat and set it down slowly inverted in the target area, until the glass is intact and stable with no collision and the other hand never touches the props
使用单手，将硼硅玻璃试管从带软垫托盘中的水平状态调整为竖直并低速插入至固定试管架: Use one hand to bring the borosilicate test tube upright from its horizontal position on the padded tray and lower it slowly into the target well of the fixed test tube rack, until the tube is intact and stable with no collision and the other hand never touches the rack
使用单手，将空12oz纸杯从防滑垫上的直立状态捏压、提起并投放至固定废弃容器内部: Use one hand to crush and lift the empty 12 oz paper cup from upright on the non-slip mat and drop it into the fixed waste container, until the cup shows clear compression, does not slip from the hand, and the other hand never touches the props
使用单手，将约50mL着色清水从250mL玻璃烧杯连续倾倒至被动固定的宽口玻璃锥: Use one hand to pour about 50 mL of tinted water continuously from the 250 mL glass beaker into the passively fixed wide-mouth glass conical flask, until both glass vessels stand stable with no obvious spillage or collision and the other hand never steadies the flask
使用双手、塑料漏斗与塑料烧杯，将约100mL清水从塑料烧杯经漏斗倾倒至空洗瓶，并: Use both hands, a plastic funnel and a plastic beaker to pour about 100 mL of clean water from the beaker through the funnel into the empty wash bottle, until the funnel is removed and returned to the tray, no obvious liquid is left on the table, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手、塑料漏斗与滤纸，将含粗砂混合液从塑料烧杯分段倾倒并过滤至塑料试剂瓶，并: Use both hands, a plastic funnel and filter paper to pour the coarse-sand mixture from the plastic beaker in stages and filter it into the plastic reagent bottle, until the level never rises above the filter paper edge, the sand stays on the paper, and no liquid overflows
使用双手、塑料烧杯与小尺寸塑料漏斗，将少量清水从塑料烧杯经漏斗缓慢倾倒至大口硼硅: Use both hands, a plastic beaker and a small plastic funnel to slowly pour a little clean water from the beaker through the funnel into the wide-mouth borosilicate test tube, until a small amount of water has been added with no obvious spillage and the beaker is returned to the table
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将15mL离心管中的约5mL着色清水从静置状态连续完成3: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw and expel the roughly 5 mL of tinted water in the 15 mL centrifuge tube three times slowly until it is roughly mixed, without obvious splashing, keeping the tube upright and returning the pipette to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将样品杯中的约5mL着色清水从静置状态连续完成3次缓慢吸: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw and expel the roughly 5 mL of tinted water in the sample cup three times slowly until it is roughly mixed, without obvious splashing, keeping the cup stable and returning the pipette to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将模拟沉淀上层清水从15mL离心管吸取并排放至废液烧杯，: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw the simulated supernatant from the 15 mL centrifuge tube and dispense it into the waste beaker, without the tip touching the coarse sand or noticeably drawing up the sediment, and return the pipette to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将烧杯底部残液从倾斜约30°的塑料烧杯吸取并排放至15m: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw the residual liquid from the plastic beaker tilted about 30° and dispense it into the 15 mL centrifuge tube, without pressing the tip against the beaker bottom, leaving no obvious liquid on the table and keeping the vessels stably placed
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将离心管中过量着色清水从约6mL液位吸取并排放至5mL目: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw the excess tinted water in the centrifuge tube from about the 6 mL level down to near the 5 mL target graduation, until the tip enters the liquid 2–4 mm, no liquid is spilled, and the pipette is returned to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将离心管内壁残留液滴从50mL离心管上半部内壁沿内壁排水: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to rinse the droplets left on the upper inner wall of the 50 mL centrifuge tube down to the bottom along the wall, keeping the tube tilted about 30°, letting no liquid run outside, and standing it upright again when finished
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将约1mL清水从塑料烧杯吸取并排放至15mL离心管，并满: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw about 1 mL of clean water from the plastic beaker and dispense it into the 15 mL centrifuge tube, until about 1 mL has been added with no obvious spillage and the pipette is returned to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将约1mL清水从塑料烧杯吸取并排放至宽口塑料样品杯中的粗: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw about 1 mL of clean water from the plastic beaker and dispense it onto the center of the coarse salt in the wide-mouth plastic sample cup, until the tip touches neither the salt nor the cup bottom, no liquid leaves the cup, and the pipette is returned to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将约1mL清水从塑料烧杯吸取并缓慢排放至大号称量船中的粗: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw about 1 mL of clean water from the plastic beaker and dispense it slowly onto the center of the coarse salt in the large weighing boat, until the salt center is visibly wet, neither liquid nor grains leave the boat, and the pipette is returned to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将约1mL着色清水从15mL离心管吸取并排放至宽口塑料样: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw about 1 mL of tinted water from the 15 mL centrifuge tube and dispense it into the wide-mouth plastic sample cup, until about 1 mL has been added, the tube stays upright, and the pipette is returned to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将约1mL着色清水从宽口塑料样品杯吸取并排放至塑料烧杯，: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw about 1 mL of tinted water from the wide-mouth plastic sample cup and dispense it into the plastic beaker, until about 1 mL has been added with no obvious spillage and the pipette is returned to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将约500μL模拟样液从塑料烧杯吸取并滴加至大号pH试纸: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw about 500 μL of simulated sample liquid from the plastic beaker and drip it onto the target area of the large pH test strip, until the tip does not touch the strip, no liquid runs over the edge, and the pipette is returned to its stand
使用双手与1mL移液枪，将约500μL清水从塑料烧杯吸取并均匀滴加至大号棉签头，: Use both hands and a 1 mL pipette to draw about 500 μL of clean water from the plastic beaker and apply it evenly to the head of the large cotton swab, until the head is evenly moistened without touching the glove or dripping continuously and the tools are returned to their places
使用双手与固定试管架，将三支带塞或带盖的空大口试管从带软垫托盘依次取出并插入至试: Use both hands and a fixed test tube rack to take three stoppered or capped empty wide-mouth test tubes one by one from the padded tray and insert them into three adjacent empty wells, until the three tubes stand side by side and each is seated before the next is picked up
使用双手与固定试管架，将匹配橡胶塞从托盘对准并按压至普通大口试管口的正常关闭位置: Use both hands and a fixed test tube rack to align a matching rubber stopper from the tray and press it into the mouth of the standard wide-mouth test tube to its normal closed position, until the stopper is secure, the tube stands upright, and no excessive force is used
使用双手与固定试管架，将匹配橡胶塞从托盘对准并缓慢按压至硼硅玻璃试管口，并满足橡: Use both hands and a fixed test tube rack to align a matching rubber stopper from the tray and press it slowly into the mouth of the borosilicate test tube, until the stopper reaches its normal closed position, the glass tube is undamaged, and no excessive force is used
使用双手与固定试管架，将匹配橡胶塞从普通大口试管口的关闭状态转动并拔出至干净托盘: Use both hands and a fixed test tube rack to twist and pull the matching rubber stopper out of the closed standard wide-mouth test tube onto a clean tray, until the tube stays upright, the stopper is fully separated, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与固定试管架，将匹配橡胶塞从硼硅玻璃试管口的关闭状态轻微转动并缓慢拔出至: Use both hands and a fixed test tube rack to twist the matching rubber stopper slightly and pull it slowly out of the closed borosilicate test tube onto the tray, until the glass tube stays upright, the stopper is fully separated, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与固定试管架，将带塞或带盖的空大口试管从试管架原孔位垂直取出并移动至试管: Use both hands and a fixed test tube rack to lift the stoppered or capped empty wide-mouth test tube vertically out of its original well and move it to the target empty well, until the tube stands upright, the original well is empty, and the rack stays stable
使用双手与固定试管架，将空硼硅玻璃试管从试管架中的直立状态垂直取出并平稳放置至带: Use both hands and a fixed test tube rack to lift the empty borosilicate test tube vertically out of the rack and set it steadily on the padded tray, until the glass tube is free of collision or damage, the rack stays stable, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与塑料搅拌棒，将含粗砂混合液从粗砂部分沉在塑料烧杯底部的状态缓慢搅拌4–: Use both hands and a plastic stirring rod to stir the mixture with coarse sand settled at the bottom of the plastic beaker four to six slow turns until the sand is redispersed, without obvious splashing or sharp tapping of the vessel, and return the stirring rod to the tray
使用双手与塑料搅拌棒，将未完全溶解的粗盐从塑料烧杯底部沿杯壁缓慢搅拌6圈至基本溶: Use both hands and a plastic stirring rod to stir the undissolved coarse salt at the bottom of the plastic beaker six slow turns along the wall until it is essentially dissolved into brine, without tapping the vessel sharply or splashing liquid, and return the stirring rod to the tray
使用双手与塑料搅拌棒，将样品杯中的盐水从粗盐未充分分散的状态缓慢搅拌约5圈至粗盐: Use both hands and a plastic stirring rod to stir the brine in the sample cup about five slow turns from a state where the coarse salt is not fully dispersed until it is visibly dispersed or partly dissolved, without obvious spillage, returning the stirring rod to the tray and ending with both hands free of contact
使用双手与塑料烧杯，将约30mL清水从塑料烧杯缓慢倒入滤纸中央并过滤至宽口塑料试: Use both hands and a plastic beaker to slowly pour about 30 mL of clean water onto the center of the filter paper and filter it into the wide-mouth plastic reagent bottle, until most of the water passes through into the bottle, the level does not overflow, and the assembly stays stable
使用双手与塑料烧杯，将约30mL着色清水从塑料烧杯缓慢倾倒至宽口塑料样品杯，并满: Use both hands and a plastic beaker to slowly pour about 30 mL of tinted water into the wide-mouth plastic sample cup, until most of the liquid is transferred, both containers rest stably, and no obvious liquid is left on the table
使用双手与塑料烧杯，将约50mL模拟液体从塑料烧杯连续倾倒至塑料锥形瓶，并满足大: Use both hands and a plastic beaker to pour about 50 mL of simulated liquid continuously from the beaker into the plastic conical flask, until most of the liquid is transferred, both vessels stand stable, and no obvious liquid is left on the table
使用双手与塑料量筒，将定量着色清水从塑料量筒连续倾倒至塑料烧杯，并满足大部分液体: Use both hands and a plastic graduated cylinder to pour the measured tinted water continuously from the cylinder into the plastic beaker, until most of the liquid is transferred, both vessels stand stable, and there is no obvious spillage
使用双手与塑料量筒，将量筒底部冲洗液从塑料量筒缓慢倾倒至废液烧杯，并满足大部分冲: Use both hands and a plastic graduated cylinder to slowly pour the rinse liquid at the bottom of the cylinder into the waste beaker, until most of it is transferred, the cylinder stands upright again, and no obvious liquid is left on the table
使用双手与大号塑料称量船，将少量粗盐从称量船形成导流口并倾倒至装有约50mL清水: Use both hands and a large plastic weighing boat to form a pouring spout and tip a little coarse salt into the plastic beaker holding about 50 mL of clean water, until no obvious residue remains in the boat, nothing is obviously scattered on the table, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与大号塑料称量船，将少量粗盐从称量船缓慢倾倒至宽口塑料样品杯中央，并满足: Use both hands and a large plastic weighing boat to slowly pour a little coarse salt into the center of the wide-mouth plastic sample cup, until most of the salt is in the cup, no obvious grains are scattered on the table, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与大号塑料转移滴管，将15mL离心管中的着色清水从离心管架中的直立状态吸: Use both hands and a large plastic transfer pipette to draw the tinted water from the 15 mL centrifuge tube standing in the rack and dispense it into the waste beaker, until the liquid in the tube is visibly reduced, the waste reaches the beaker, and the rack stays stable
使用双手与大号塑料转移滴管，将培养皿内着色清水从塑料培养皿底皿重复吸取并排放至废: Use both hands and a large plastic transfer pipette to repeatedly draw the tinted water from the plastic Petri dish base and dispense it into the waste beaker, until the liquid in the dish is visibly reduced, no obvious liquid is on the table, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与大号塑料转移滴管，将少量模拟样液从宽口塑料样品杯吸取并滴加至大号pH试: Use both hands and a large plastic transfer pipette to draw a little simulated sample liquid from the wide-mouth plastic sample cup and drip it onto the target area of the large pH test strip, until the target area is visibly wet, no liquid obviously runs over the edge, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与大号塑料转移滴管，将少量清水从塑料烧杯吸取并缓慢滴加至大号棉签头表面，: Use both hands and a large plastic transfer pipette to draw a little clean water from the plastic beaker and drip it slowly onto the head of the large cotton swab, until the head is visibly moist without dripping continuously and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与大号塑料转移滴管，将模拟培养液从塑料烧杯吸取并滴加至塑料培养皿底皿，并: Use both hands and a large plastic transfer pipette to draw simulated culture medium from the plastic beaker and drip it into the plastic Petri dish base, until a thin layer forms on the bottom, no liquid runs over the edge, and the pipette is returned to the tray
使用双手与大号塑料转移滴管，将着色清水从塑料烧杯分次吸取并排放至普通大口试管目标: Use both hands and a large plastic transfer pipette to draw tinted water from the plastic beaker in portions and dispense it into the standard wide-mouth test tube up to the target mark, until the tube stays upright, no liquid runs down the outside, and the pipette is returned to the tray
使用双手与大号塑料转移滴管，将着色清水从宽口塑料样品杯吸取并排放至15mL离心管: Use both hands and a large plastic transfer pipette to draw tinted water from the wide-mouth plastic sample cup and dispense it into the 15 mL centrifuge tube, until a small amount has been added, the tube stays upright, and no obvious liquid is spilled on the table
使用双手与宽口塑料样品杯，将约30mL着色清水从塑料样品杯缓慢倾倒至塑料烧杯，并: Use both hands and a wide-mouth plastic sample cup to slowly pour about 30 mL of tinted water into the plastic beaker, until most of the liquid is transferred, both containers rest stably, and there is no obvious spillage
使用双手与宽口塑料试剂瓶，将着色清水从塑料试剂瓶连续倾倒至塑料量筒目标刻度，并满: Use both hands and a wide-mouth plastic reagent bottle to pour tinted water continuously into the plastic graduated cylinder up to the target graduation, until the level is close to the target line, both vessels stand stable, and no obvious liquid is left on the table
使用双手与宽口塑料试剂瓶，将约50mL过滤后模拟清水从塑料试剂瓶缓慢倾倒至塑料烧: Use both hands and a wide-mouth plastic reagent bottle to slowly pour about 50 mL of filtered simulated clear water into the plastic beaker, until most of the liquid is transferred, both containers rest stably, and there is no obvious spillage
使用双手与沥水架，将清洗后的塑料量筒从防滑垫上的直立状态翻转180°并放置至沥水: Use both hands and a drying rack to turn the washed plastic graduated cylinder 180° from upright on the non-slip mat and place it inverted on the drying rack, until the cylinder is stable with no obvious water pooled inside and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与洗瓶，将培养皿底部着色残留从倒空后的塑料培养皿冲洗并倾倒至废液烧杯，并: Use both hands and a wash bottle to rinse the tinted residue from the emptied plastic Petri dish and pour it into the waste beaker, until the visible staining is reduced, the dish is set back level, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与洗瓶，将塑料烧杯内壁残留从附着少量着色液体的状态冲洗并倾倒至废液烧杯，: Use both hands and a wash bottle to rinse the residue from the plastic beaker holding a little tinted liquid and pour it into the waste beaker, until the beaker being cleaned stands upright again, no obvious liquid is left on the table, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与洗瓶，将塑料试管内壁着色残留从固定试管架中的直立塑料试管沿内壁冲洗至试: Use both hands and a wash bottle to rinse the tinted residue down the inner wall of the upright plastic test tube in the fixed rack into a small pool of rinse liquid at the bottom, until the staining is visibly reduced, the tube stays upright, and the wash bottle is returned to the table
使用双手与洗瓶，将塑料量筒内壁着色残留从空塑料量筒内壁沿内壁冲洗至量筒底部的少量: Use both hands and a wash bottle to rinse the tinted residue down the inner wall of the empty plastic graduated cylinder into a small pool of rinse liquid at the bottom, until the staining is visibly reduced, the cylinder stays upright, and the wash bottle is returned to the table
使用双手与洗瓶，将干燥大号圆形滤纸从塑料漏斗中的未贴合状态沿表面缓慢挤压清水1–: Use both hands and a wash bottle to squeeze clean water once or twice over the dry large circular filter paper sitting loosely in the plastic funnel until it is wetted throughout and clings to the funnel, without spilling liquid, keeping the filtration assembly stable and ending with both hands free of contact
使用双手与洗瓶，将漏斗内壁残留混合液从过滤装置沿内壁冲洗至塑料试剂瓶，并满足粗砂: Use both hands and a wash bottle to rinse the mixture left on the funnel wall down into the plastic reagent bottle, until the coarse sand remains on the filter paper, no obvious liquid is left on the table, and both hands end free of contact
使用双手与洗瓶，将空塑料漏斗内壁从废液烧杯上方沿内壁挤压清水1–2次进行冲洗至冲: Use both hands and a wash bottle to rinse the inner wall of the empty plastic funnel over the waste beaker with one or two squeezes of clean water, until the funnel wall is visibly wet, all rinse liquid has entered the beaker, and no obvious liquid is left on the table
使用双手与湿润大号棉签，将塑料培养皿中央区域从干燥状态小圆周擦拭2–3圈至明显湿: Use both hands and a moistened large cotton swab to wipe the center of the plastic Petri dish in two or three small circles until it is visibly wet, keeping the dish level, returning the swab to the tray and ending with both hands free of contact
